summary: High-resolution timer reference-delta query. Dispatches a fresh timestamp through QueryPerformanceCounterWrapperWithModeDispatch, subtracts the stored reference timestamp at this+0x18/0x1C, and converts the tick delta to seconds using the frequency word at this+0x0 and the reciprocal scaling factor at this+0x8. Does not modify any stored field.

operations.description: Read reference timestamp low part from this+0x18.
Read reference timestamp high part from this+0x1C.
Query the current performance counter timestamp through QueryPerformanceCounterWrapperWithModeDispatch, writing low part and high part.
Compute 64-bit delta as current timestamp minus the stored reference timestamp.
Read timer frequency low word at this+0x0 and divide the delta low part by it.
Multiply the delta high part by the reciprocal scaling factor at this+0x8 and add the low-part quotient to obtain elapsed seconds.
Return the computed elapsed time in seconds since the reference timestamp.

unresolved: Whether the reference timestamp at this+0x18/0x1C is set by a separate reset call is not established by this packet.
